title: cyperus rutilans
intro: Cyperus rutilans, commonly known as Red Papyrus, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the Cyperaceae family. The plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatic pain, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus rutilans include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Cyperus rutilans have been shown to exhibit potential medicinal properties, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
